svg.title: Horizontal pull: muscles trained and joint angles
svg.desc: Posterior view of the upper back with the trapezius, latissimus dorsi and posterior deltoid highlighted, the shoulder and elbow lines marked, and a side column showing the start and end position, joint angle curves and muscle action timing.
svg.text: The rhomboid is dashed: it lies under the trapezius and cannot be seen on this view.
Base figure: OpenStax, Anatomy and Physiology, figure 11.5. Labels removed, cropped. CC BY 4.0.
